sentence_stem: Although I would love to come to your party,
correct_completion: I have to work that evening.
full_sentence: Although I would love to come to your party, I have to work that evening.
acceptable_variants: I will not be able to join you.
I still have to work that evening.

options.text: I have to work that evening.

options.why_wrong: This gives a time but does not express the contrast that 'although' requires.

explanation: After 'although', the sentence needs a clause that contrasts with the first part. Here the speaker wants to come, but a work commitment prevents it. Learners often add a result clause with 'so' by mistake, so check the connector first.
